# Santosh Lad Foundation
> Official web platform of Santosh S. Lad — Minister for Labour, Government of Karnataka, and Member of Legislative Assembly (MLA) from Kalaghatagi constituency.

## Key Sections
- [Homepage](https://www.santoshladfoundation.org/): Leadership, public service initiatives, Labour Department programs, and Janatha Darshan.
- [Latest Updates](https://www.santoshladfoundation.org/latest): Press releases, developmental updates, rescue operations, and community announcements.
- [Photo & Media Gallery](https://www.santoshladfoundation.org/gallery): High-resolution imagery from public events, rescue initiatives, and constituency meetings.
- [Interactive Timeline](https://www.santoshladfoundation.org/timeline): 3D visual journey through career milestones and public service history.

## Public Service & Key Focus Areas
- **Labour Welfare:** Policy initiatives, worker protection, social security programs across Karnataka.
- **Constituency Leadership:** Kalaghatagi developmental infrastructure, Janatha Darshan public grievance redressal.
- **Disaster Response & Rescue:** High-visibility field leadership in national & regional rescue missions (Uttarakhand flood relief, Wayanad disaster response).

## Organization & Contact Details
- **Founder & Leader:** Santosh S. Lad
- **Office:** Kalaghatagi, Dharwad District, Karnataka, India
- **Official Domain:** https://www.santoshladfoundation.org/
